 Atalanta vs Frosinone Atalanta Frosinone Serie A Follow the eighth round of Serie A LIVE with us.
 Serie A, matchday 8 
 Atalanta 1-2 Frosinone 
 Scorers: 1' Schmid (F), 14' Krstovic (A), 17' Schimd (F) 
 On Sunday at 3pm , Atalanta host Frosinone at the New Balance Arena in Bergamo in the eighth round of Serie A . The hosts come into the game after a cruel blow against Ajax in the Conference League, while the visitors have made an excellent start to the season. Maurizio Sarri needs a win after successive defeats to Milan and Ajax. His Atalanta are struggling more than expected. Massimiliano Alvini is doing exceptionally well: the Ciociari have four wins, one draw and two defeats in the league. Antonio Raimondo deserves plenty of credit. He's the league's top scorer alongside Monza's Varela. 
 The goals and highlights:
 17' - Frosinone again, Schmid again! Ghedjemis outmuscles Obric, breaks into the box and lays the ball off to the onrushing Austrian. He side-foots home with his right foot for his second goal and a 2-1 Frosinone lead. 
 14' - Atalanta equalise, Krstovic! Rowe dribbles past Calvani and finds De Ketelaere, whose through ball sends the Montenegrin one-on-one with Palmisani. He makes no mistake. 
 1' - Frosinone score straight away, Schimid! Ederson receives a pass from Obric but finds the Austrian in the centre of the box. He shoots to put Frosinone ahead after 30 seconds. 
 The match details
 Atalanta-Frosinone 1-2

 FROSINONE (4-2-3-1): Palmisani; Oyono, Calvani, Cittadini, Bracaglia; Calò, Masini; Ghedjemis, Schmid, Kvernadze; Raimondo. Manager: Alvini. 
 Booked: Bracaglia (F)

 Assists: De Kerelaere (A), Ghedjemis (F) 
 Referee: Marinelli
